name: Arzachena (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arzachena (a rock on blue above a red ring on white) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Arzachena, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Arzachena arms — rock on blue above a red ring on white, crowned, within branches
